result.reason: The clause adds professional/workmanlike performance, legal compliance, malicious-code protection, and a conformance warranty, but it omits any warranty duration, so it reaches neither the preferred nor fallback position. The remedy is also ambiguously tied only to the Interface conformance warranty, while referring to fees for “non-conforming services”; it does not clearly provide repair, replacement, or refund remedies for both software and services. The conformance warranty covers only the Interface rather than all applicable deliverables/software. Adding a new service standard while leaving Section 11 unchanged creates unnecessary overlap instead of revising the existing standard-of-care provision. Unrelated intent is otherwise preserved.
